protocol.bands: volume-weighted HLC3 mean and population variance, separately on closed 1m/5m/30m bars
protocol.profile: 48 HLC3-volume bins from the previous complete UTC day; three-bin smoothing
protocol.nodes: local HVN >= 1.25 times mean or positive local LVN <= 0.75 times mean
protocol.pivots: strict low with two bars on each side; usable only after right-side bars close
protocol.delta: session sum of signed 1m volume; sign from candle direction, flat bars inherit direction
protocol.delta_normalization: difference at two outside-band pivots / session CVD range known at confirmation
protocol.confirmation: at a common 30m close, all three closed-bar band readings are inside +/-2 sigma
protocol.targets: signal-time 1m session VWAP and upper 1-sigma band, frozen through the trade
protocol.trend_filter: last 30m change in 1m VWAP / current sigma >= -0.25
protocol.windows: first 70% of elapsed history and later 30%, split at UTC midnight; separately funded
protocol.gaps: no fabricated bars; session and prior-day profile must be complete; open account stops at a gap
protocol.selection: all four fixed variants reported; no winner selection, optimization or model promotion

reports.scope: Each window, market, variant and cost scenario has a separate $500 account. Historical research only; no independent forward confirmation. No synthetic market fallback.
limitations: Crypto adaptation, not an exact replication of private futures rules.
Candle direction delta and HLC3 volume profile are approximations, not aggressor trades or resting orders.
Fixed research thresholds were specified before this comparison; no optimizer or Wednesday exclusion.
Stops take precedence over targets within ambiguous minute bars; partial exits pay fees.
No automatic learning, qualification, profile replacement or real orders.
